description_en: Revokes permissions on resources from Data Management (DMS) users by using a permission template
description_zh: 回收权限模板中的资源权限
name: RevokeTemplateAuthority

parameters.help_en: The ID of the permission template
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of users from whom you want to revoke permissions by using a permission template
parameters.help_zh: 待回收资源权限的用户ID列表
parameters.name: user_ids

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to query the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request failed

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed

Result.description_en: Indicates whether the permissions were revoked from the users
Result.description_zh: 是否已回收该用户的模板权限

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
